definition: Idealistic means guided by high principles rather than practical concerns.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word idealistic. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know idealistic should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The new principal arrived idealistic, convinced that if lessons were engaging enough, the detention room would empty itself within a year.
Hopeful expects things may improve; idealistic goes further, steering choices by a vision of how things ought to be, practicality aside.
Utopian outruns idealistic: the idealistic reformer believes the city can be far better, while the utopian planner sketches a city with no conflict at all.

High-minded praises the loftiness of someone's principles - noble aims, sincerely held. Idealistic adds a caution: those principles are steering real decisions while practical obstacles get waved aside. A high-minded judge applies noble standards to the case; an idealistic planner budgets as if the world already met them.

Starry-eyed is the gentle tease for dreamy, naive hopefulness - eyes shining, feet well off the ground. Idealistic is sturdier and more respectable: guided by genuine principles about how things should be, even while practicality is set aside. Starry-eyed mocks the dreamer; idealistic can still be praise.
judging by how things actually are
experienced in how the world really works

When the city announced a design contest for housing on the old rail yard, most firms submitted safe, boxy proposals.
Elena Marsh submitted a garden city: courtyards, shared workshops, apartments priced so that a bus driver could live beside a surgeon.
The jury loved it; the spreadsheet did not.

Her plan was priced as if every contractor would donate labor, and reporters began calling the young architect idealistic, a designer steering by how the city ought to live rather than by what the lots would cost.
Marsh took the word as half compliment, half warning.
She spent a winter re-drawing: fewer courtyards, cheaper cladding, the shared workshops kept.
The revised plan broke ground two years later, its principles intact and its arithmetic finally sound.
